notes.title: First Update
notes.content:
Good day Koshari Fans! Today we bring you our first update on steam!
In this announcement we will give you an overview of all new features and content.

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Touch-controls
[*] Changes to the UI for different screen formats and resolutions
[*] A settings page for language, volume and more
[*] A spectator-mode at the end of a level
[*] Towers can now be placed with Drag-and-Drop
[*] New targeting-option: "Weakest"
[*] And many more small changes (which are less interesting)
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Levels[/h2]
With this update we not only bring new features but we also created a whole new level:
[list]
[*] Clashing Currents
[i]A difficult level that provides you with all 3 current towers![/i]
[/list]
In addition to our new level we also reworked the following level to make it more thrilling:
[list]
[*] Between the Fronts
[i]Now shorter but definitely not easier![/i]
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

Due to an internal issue between the old and new builds, many players may experience a loss of their Steam progress. 
As a side effect, some players' itch.io progress will be overwritten by their Steam progress.
We are very sorry that this happened. It should not happen in future updates.

[hr][/hr]

[h3]You got feedback for us?[/h3]
In case you guys find bugs or have ideas for improvements, you can contact us via our support email!

[h2]Good luck and have fun playing! 🧡[/h2]
